cat > /workdir/play.py <<'PY'
import arena,subprocess,sys
seconds=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else '30'
for _ in range(int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 1):
    b=arena.load_board()
    if arena.result(b):
        arena.show(b);break
    h=b.copy();hist=[]
    while h.move_stack:
        h.pop();hist.append(h.fen())
    open('history.txt','w').write('\n'.join(hist))
    p=subprocess.run(['./think',b.fen(),seconds,'history.txt'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    lines=p.stdout.splitlines()
    print('\n'.join(lines[-3:]),flush=True)
    m=lines[-1].split()[1]
    import chess
    assert chess.Move.from_uci(m) in b.legal_moves
    arena.cmd_move(m)
    sys.stdout.flush()
PY
